display.purpose: Per-class quantities in the parts list (TOTAL at 6rem). Tabular figures, text stroke 0.035em.

headline.purpose: Camera message title; same band carries the wordmark (5.4rem, 0.16em), clock (4.6rem) and S1 state (4.4rem).

title.purpose: Part names; band 2.6-3.6rem covers PRESENT lines, block names, TOTAL and the banner title.

body.purpose: Reference rows, designators, title-block values; camera detail at 2.6rem, max 60ch.

label.purpose: Table headers, title-block field names, S1 reference, rulers, notes, commands. Always floored in px.

pens.name: pen-1
pens.purpose: ISO 0.25 mm: internal table and title-block rules, ruler cells.

pens.name: pen-3
pens.purpose: ISO 0.5 mm: drawn objects and controls (blocks, tables, commands, stamp, focus outline).

pens.name: pen-4
pens.purpose: ISO 0.7 mm: sheet frame, title block, connection banner.

scaling.purpose: 1rem = 10px at 1920x1080; the 192x108rem sheet scales as one drawing. Lettering under 2rem uses max(Nrem, 11-14px) floors.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Sheet easing for every state transition.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Ink, border and mark colour changes; ruler zone wash.

motion.name: lever
motion.purpose: S1 lever swinging open or closed.

motion.name: camera-dim
motion.purpose: Camera canvas fading and greying when the picture is lost.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: One pulse along the live S1 wire per detection result; max 8 in flight.

motion.name: busy-blink
motion.purpose: Busy block outline alternating ink and non-repro blue.

motion.name: hold-exit
motion.purpose: Exit cell ink fill while held; kept under reduced motion as feedback.

narrative.overview:
Vizion's screen is an electronics drawing: drafting film, navy ink laid down at ISO pen widths, non-repro blue construction lines, and ISO 3098 lettering. Every surface is a drafted object with a real counterpart on a sheet: a framed drawing area with zone rulers, net-label flags on detected parts, a block diagram with a working switch, a ruled parts list, a reference table, a notes line and a title block. Nothing floats, glows or lifts; state is shown by changing the ink, the line style or the hatching.

The sheet is laid out once, at 1920×1080, and scales as one drawing. `1rem` is 10px at 1080p (`font-size: min(100vh / 108, 100vw / 192)` on `:root`), so every measurement in this file is a drawing measurement and the whole sheet keeps its proportions on any screen. Small lettering carries pixel floors (`max(1.4rem, 12px)` and similar) so it stays legible when the sheet shrinks.

Density is that of a working drawing: tight ruled cells, generous only where something must read from 3 m (counts, the switch state, the clock, the wordmark).
keyCharacteristics: Flat drafting film with a 2rem non-repro dot grid; no shadows, no rounded containers.
One typeface (osifont, ISO 3098) at one weight; emphasis is pen weight, drawn with text stroke.
Strokes come from four ISO pen widths; line style (solid, dashed, hatched) carries state alongside colour.
Class inks are reserved: orange for resistors, teal for capacitors, red pen for faults only.
Real schematic symbols (zigzag resistor, two-plate capacitor, SPST switch), drawn as SVG.

rules.name: The Reserved Ink Rule
rules.body: Resistor ink, capacitor ink and red pen each name one thing. A colour that means "resistor" is never borrowed for emphasis, and red pen never appears unless something has failed.

rules.name: The Not By Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every coloured state also changes form: PRESENT fills the mark square, idle states dash the outline, faults hatch the block, the open switch dashes its wire. Remove the colour and the state still reads.

rules.name: The Pen Weight Rule
rules.body: osifont has one weight; never set `font-weight` for emphasis. Emphasis is drawn with `-webkit-text-stroke` in `currentColor`, from 0.02em (block names) through 0.035–0.045em (counts, switch state, PRESENT) to 0.05em (wordmark).

rules.name: The Lettering Floor Rule
rules.body: Any lettering below 2rem carries a pixel floor (`max(Nrem, 11–14px)`) so the scaled sheet never letters smaller than a reader can resolve. Designators use line-height 1.3, because osifont's capitals rise above the em box and a tighter line clips them.

rules.name: The Pen Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Boundaries are ranked by ISO pen width, never by shadow: pen-1 (0.1rem) for internal rules, pen-2 (0.15rem) for header rules, pen-3 (0.2rem) for drawn objects and controls, pen-4 (0.3rem) for the sheet frame, title block and banners.

dos: **Do** measure everything in rem on the 1920×1080 drawing (1rem = 10px) and let the root font size scale the sheet; give any lettering under 2rem a pixel floor.
**Do** draw boundaries with the four pen widths (0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3rem) and let line style (solid, dashed, hatched) carry state with colour.
**Do** keep every class colour bound to its class: resistor ink for resistors, capacitor ink for capacitors, red pen for faults only.
**Do** use real schematic symbols and drafting furniture (net-label flags, ruled tables, title-block cells, reference designators like R1, C1, S1) for new elements.
**Do** show emphasis with text stroke in `currentColor`, never with a heavier weight or a second typeface.
**Do** put a paper keyline under anything inked over the camera picture.
**Do** use the sheet ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) at 150–300ms, and stop all motion under reduced motion except hold-to-exit feedback.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, glows, blur or smooth gradients; the only gradients on the sheet are the dot grid and 45° hatching.
**Don't** round container corners; round forms are kept to terminals and line caps.
**Don't** letter text in non-repro blue or grid dot.
**Don't** use red pen for anything but a fault or a lost connection.
**Don't** use icon fonts or emoji; a symbol is a drawn SVG schematic symbol or lettering.
**Don't** add a small tracked label above a heading as decoration; small tracked lettering names a field in a ruled cell or a table column, nothing else.
